message: Mac Phase 0 acceptance evidence: doctor reported READY and the deterministic self-test passed all exact-SHA/idempotency/report checks. The initial test collection used a bare pytest command and failed to import runner; repository governance already requires python -m pytest. A separate SyntaxWarning from return inside finally was corrected in runner/execution.py, and README now documents the canonical interpreter-bound validation command. Phase 0 remains in validation pending one clean Mac rerun of the canonical unit-test command.

changes.next_action: On the Mac, update to current main and run python -m pytest -q, then rerun doctor and self-test to confirm the warning is gone.
